title: EG&G interview switched mid-way to the S-4 job
summary: Bob Lazar tells of EG&G interview switched mid-way to the S-4 job, about 1988 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: interviewed me for that and somewhere in the middle of it they said, "You know, we actually have a different job that we're thinking of plugging you into now."

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on secret craft in Nevada, says that in 1988 he went for a job interview at EG&G, a government contractor in Las Vegas. He says that partway through, the interviewers told him they actually had a different job in mind for him, which led him to a secret work site he calls S-4, the place where, if his story is true, he saw hidden technology.
